run_main: run the main function to extract communication from a trained POP game using checkpoint parameters
eval_game_interactions: evaluate a sender-receiver game on validation data and return the collected interactions
dump_interactions: save interaction logs to a specified directory using torch save with retry logic
build_and_test_game: build a POP game from options, evaluate all agent pairs, and save their interactions
review_eval: review the eval function that runs forward passes through a game and collects interactions
